classification: authored synthetic regression; no held-out claim
definition: input_bytes means canonical deterministically redacted retained segment bytes, excluding transport/base64 overhead; source_revisions means accepted logical source versions, including explicit pre019 retention once
cases: accepted segment counts retained input_bytes and one source_revisions atomically in source transaction
identical accepted retry and explicit retain-existing do not double-count
